customInstructions: Enforce universal 0px straight-line geometry: all cards, badges, buttons, and containers must use rounded-none exclusively. Rounded corners are strictly forbidden.
Enforce bilateral corridor boundary: Tac-Xpress operates exclusively on the New Delhi <-> Imphal (DEL <-> IMF) corridor. All other cities/routes are invalid.
Enforce freight STEM purity: all dimensional weight, fuel surcharge, and GST formulas in lib/stem/ must remain pure functions without side effects.
Prohibit em dashes: never write em dashes (—) in UI text, placeholders, or error messages.
Enforce Ponytail standard: prioritize minimal surgical diffs and zero speculative abstractions or wrapper sprawl.
Enforce TypeScript strictness: prohibit any, unvalidated as Type casts, and non-null ! assertions.
